test_rename_columns_by_prefix_basic: test rename_columns_by_prefix to rename DataFrame columns using a prefix mapping dictionary
test_rename_columns_by_prefix_time_prese: test rename_columns_by_prefix preserves the default time column when renaming other columns
test_rename_columns_by_prefix_custom_tim: test rename_columns_by_prefix with a custom time_col_name parameter to preserve a non-default time column
test_rename_columns_by_prefix_zero_match: test rename_columns_by_prefix raises ValueError when a prefix matches zero columns in the DataFrame
test_rename_columns_by_prefix_multi_matc: test rename_columns_by_prefix raises ValueError when a prefix matches multiple columns in the DataFrame
